title: Empowering Entrepreneurs to Stay at the Forefront of Logistics
summary: Landstar Vice President and Chief Safety & Operations Officer Joe Beacom spoke at Reuters Events Supply Chain USA Virtual about how entrepreneurs can stay at the forefront of the logistics industry.
body_markdown:
Landstar Vice President and Chief Safety & Operations Officer Joe Beacom recently spoke at[Reuters Events Supply Chain USA Virtual](https://reutersevents.com/events/3pl/) about how entrepreneurs can stay at the forefront of the logistics industry. Watch the video to hear his expert insight.


Entrepreneurs at Landstar have the freedom to run their businesses their way, with the support of a reputable leader in the industry. To learn more about the opportunities available for independent freight agents and owner-operators,[click here for more information](https://www.landstar.com/why-landstar/entrepreneurs/) .
